text: ちぇ　てんで　かてないや

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる turns 'win' into 'can win', and ない makes it 'cannot'. かてない = 'can't win'.

patterns.name: 〜や (to oneself)
patterns.explanation: や at the end of a sentence is a casual sigh to yourself, giving up on something. かてないや = 'I just can't win'.
